title: Certificate split on concatenated strings
statement: Let $C,c$ be natural numbers and let $x,u$ be finite bit strings. If $|u|=C(|x|+1)^c$, then the certificate split of the concatenation $xu$ is the self-delimiting pair encoding of $x$ and $u$.
